notes.subject: יאמרך
notes.rationale: 'Who say you (your name) for wicked purpose' — object supplied: 'thee' vs 'thy name' (KJV) vs JPS 'utter Thy name'.

notes.subject: נשא לשוא
notes.rationale: Literally 'lift up for emptiness/falseness'; rendered 'sailim long nating' — idiom of taking/bearing in vain.

notes.subject: עריך
notes.rationale: Lemma ar 'watchful foe': 'your enemies' vs literal 'those who watch you (for mischief)'.

translation: Dispela ol, ol i tokim nem bilong yu long tingting nogut; ol birua bilong yu, ol i sailim ⟨em⟩ long nating.

tokens.gloss: ol i tokim nem bilong yu
